## Gnoll Commando (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
Gnoll fighter 1/rogue 1  
CE Medium humanoid (gnoll)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+4 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural, +1 shield)  
**hp** 47 (4 HD; 3d8+1d10+9)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +4, **Will** +1  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** mwk battleaxe +7 (1d8+4/x3) or +6 (1d8+6/x3)  
**Ranged** javelin +4 (1d6+4) or mwk rifle +5 (1d10/x4)  
**Special Attacks** sneak attack +1d6  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Commandos typically ride savage mounts into battle (often dire boars or similarly savage creatures rather than mere horses), using their speed to making sweeping melee attacks or to keep their distance while sniping at enemies. If closely pressed, they leap onto opponents’ mounts or vehicles or try to hamper them with alchemist’s fire or tanglefoot bags to disable opponents’ mounts or vehicles to keep their mobility advantage.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 19, **Dex** 14, **Con** 15, **Int** 6, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 19  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Mounted Combat, Ride-By Attack  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +8, Handle Animal +3, Perception +5, Ride +5, Survival +6  
**Languages** Gnoll  
**SQ** trapfinding +1  
**Combat Gear** potions of cure light wounds (2), alchemist’s fire (2), tanglefoot bags (2); **Other Gear** masterwork light trooper armor, masterwork buckler, masterwork battleaxe, masterwork rifle with 10 metal cartridges, javelins (5)
